description: This Java class defines a factory for creating various types of loggers and logging adapters specifically for the Ditto project, integrating SLF4J and Akka logging frameworks. It provides methods to obtain standard, thread-safe, and diagnostic loggers and adapters, primarily tailored for actor-based concurrency models in Akka.

classes.name: DittoLoggerFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing static methods to obtain various types of loggers and logging adapters for use within the Ditto project, particularly in conjunction with Akka actors and SLF4J logging.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance associated with the specified class, using SLF4J's LoggerFactory. It checks the input for null to prevent errors.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a DittoLogger instance associated with the specified name, using SLF4J's LoggerFactory. It checks the input for null.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger instance associated with the specified class, suitable for concurrent use.

methods.name: getThreadSafeLogger
methods.description: Returns a thread-safe DittoLogger instance associated with the specified name.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Provides a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for a given Akka Actor, with MDC support, facilitating detailed actor-based logging.

methods.name: getThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe LoggingAdapter for a specified Akka Actor, with MDC support.

methods.name: getDiagnosticLoggingAdapterFactory
methods.description: Internal helper method transforming an Actor reference into a Supplier for DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, used internally for MDC-enabled logging.
